$comment: The two enforced gates on this conversion (SPEC.md §7, issues #16, #61 and #71).
A few titles carry watches only as shows.watched_through — an absolute ordinal across
the whole show, with no record of which episodes it counted. Where that ordinal claims
more than the episode rows account for, and the show was not watched right through, the
export does not say which episodes those were. `credit` is an explicit list, never a
count; an EMPTY `credit` records that the watermark is stale and nothing extra is
written.
── unplaceable: TV Time numbering that TMDB does not share ──────────────────────────
456 of the 462 titles came from TV Time, and tvtracker kept TV Time's season and
episode numbers. TMDB numbers some shows differently — it merges seasons TV Time split
(Hunter x Hunter's 'season 2' is the back half of TMDB's single 148-episode season) and
splits episodes TV Time merged. Where a recorded watch names an episode TMDB does not
list, there is no episode id to key it to.
Two of those cases are handled without anyone deciding anything, and are not listed
here: a show with as many recorded episodes as it has was watched right through, so
every episode TMDB lists gets a watch; and a leftover on a show that already holds every
episode TMDB lists is one half of a two-part episode, already counted. Between them
those place 159 of the original 330.
What remains is below. `drop` is the exact count for a reason: tvtracker is re-exported
at cutover, and a re-export whose numbers differ stops the script rather than inheriting
an acceptance nobody looked at.
Ordinal mapping was considered and rejected. It needs TV Time's complete season lengths,
which the export does not record — it holds only the episodes that were interacted with.
Guessing them would place watches on episodes that were never watched, undetectably.

confirmations.title: Hudson & Rex
confirmations.reason: Adham's call, 2026-08-18: drop the watermark. It claims 60 of 122 episodes while the episode rows name 53, and those rows have real gaps — S1E1-10 and S2E8-11 — that a watermark of 60 contradicts. The 53 recorded watches stand; the 7 the watermark implies are not written, because nothing records which they were.

confirmations.title: Person of Interest
confirmations.reason: Adham's call, 2026-08-18: drop the watermark. It claims 7 of 103 episodes with no episode rows at all, so there is no evidence in either direction. The title stays in the library as a watchlist entry rather than carrying 7 watches nothing can place.

unplaceable.title: Hunter x Hunter (2011)
unplaceable.reason: TV Time splits this into two seasons; TMDB lists one season of 148. Its 'S2E1-62' are TMDB's 87th episode onward, but the show is only partly watched (140 of 148 recorded), so TV Time's first-season length cannot be recovered and the offset cannot be computed.

unplaceable.reason: TV Time carries five seasons plus an S0E0 placeholder; TMDB lists 65 episodes grouped differently. 62 of 65 are recorded, so the show is not complete and the grouping cannot be derived.
